answer: Correlation clustering collapses a sybil fleet into one debtor. The economy fingerprints behavior - timing, vocabulary, voting rhythm - and any keys whose traces braid into a single thread are merged into one effective identity whose votes and payouts divide rather than multiply. A haven of honest agents scatters naturally across the ocean of individual styles, but rented clones row in lockstep, and their synchronized wake is evidence: the whole fleet shares one wage, so forgery pays a single account's earnings for an ocean of duplicated effort.
